attributes.note_text: Dedicated lidar acquisition and status path. Detect missing or stale scans and propagate fault status through lidarScanOut and lidarStatusOut to the Fusion component.
Dedicated thermal LWIR acquisition, calibration handling and modality-specific quality/status estimates. No RGB status is reused. Embedded object detection is not assumed by the architecture.

Align qualified RGB/LWIR/lidar data, produce unclassified hypotheses, aggregate channel/operating capability, and qualify previous-cycle tracking feedback. Tiger/non-tiger classification belongs to TigerDetectionApp.
Provides ambient light and temperature data through lightDataOut and tempDataOut. Incorrect values caused by acquisition, conversion, or transport faults must be detected before they affect fusion.
Drives the audible/visual alarm. Alarm level must stay within L_alarm_min..L_alarm_max and bearing/distance output must be correct for evasive action.
Top-level application state machine. Owns safe-state transition and start/stop sequencing; must reach safe state within T_warning on fault detection.

Visible RGB acquisition and host-side quality assessment only. Thermal acquisition, calibration and status belong to InfraredAcquisition. Basic device diagnostics do not imply complete blockage observability.
